next_test: Decompose candidate source anchors into the four Fourier-character sectors. Determine whether a zero-free cyclic anchor orbit eta_0,...,eta_3 exists with the Tate fourfold phase and whether the resulting one-leg pair-to-border map sends the stable endpoint mismatch exactly to a nonzero multiple of tau.
conclusion: The missing bridge cannot be the ordinary group-like diagonal. Divisor multiplicity forces it to be linear in exactly one Evans leg. Categorically, the needed object is a pointed, possibly Tate-twisted C4 orbit of anchors supplying a one-leg polarization map into the ordered-pair G4 carrier.
